Definition: properly, a mumble, i.e. a water skin (from its hollow sound); hence a necromancer (ventriloquist, as from a jar)
BiblicalUsage: 1) water skin bottle; 2) necromancer; 1b) necromancer, one who evokes the dead; 1c) ghost, spirit of a dead one; 1d) practice of necromancy; 3) one that has a familiar spirit
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
